clips.title: The story
paras: Following the reduction of the rogue colonel's rank-and-file soldiers, Sergeant Yohwa asks you to target the elite core of the compound. You are sent into the Stockpile cave to eliminate the commandos and headshrinkers before reporting to Lieutenant Doren.

With the regular soldiers of the Kurzen Compound diminished through the work of the Second Rebellion, Sergeant Yohwa sets her sights on the colonel's elite specialists. She knows many of Kurzen's troops personally and calls them skilled, loyal and cruel. When they are not out in the wilderness slaughtering rebel soldiers, they are found in a cave at the back of the compound called the Stockpile. To break their strength, you are sent into the cavern to dispatch ten Kurzen Commandos and six Kurzen Headshrinkers.
After the fight, Sergeant Yohwa tells you to report to her commanding officer, Lieutenant Doren, at the Rebel Camp, who will want your account firsthand.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Now that many of his regular troops are reduced, you must face his highly trained forces. When they're not in the wilderness slaughtering our rebel soldiers, they are found deep in the back of the Kurzen Compound, in a cave they call the Stockpile.
I know many of Kurzen's troops personally, and I know they are skilled, loyal, and cruel. This is no easy task I set before you, friend.
After you defeat them, report to Lieutenant Doren, my commanding officer. He will want your report firsthand.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Sergeant Yohwa tells me you are skilled and brave, adventurer. Do you have something to report?

clips.title: Completion
paras: Friend. Sergeant Yohwa trusted your abilities, and I trust her. The defeat you brought to Kurzen's forces is almost too much to hope for. I had feared we rebels were alone, and alone we could never stand up against the Colonel's brilliance.
Perhaps hope of our survival yet remains.
